description: The bar chart, titled "Average Performance," displays the performance of five different methods, with the y-axis representing "Average Performance" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. The x-axis lists the methods: "Standard," "Self-RAG," "FactTune," "CInGS (w/)," and "CInGS (w/o)." The bars are colored differently: "Standard" is orange, "Self-RAG" is olive green, "FactTune" is lime green, "CInGS (w/)" is blue, and "CInGS (w/o)" is gray. The performance values are approximately: "Standard" at 53, "Self-RAG" at 54, "FactTune" at 52, "CInGS (w/)" at 54, and "CInGS (w/o)" at 59. The chart shows that "CInGS (w/o)" has the highest average performance, followed by "Self-RAG" and "CInGS (w/)" at nearly equal levels, with "Standard" and "FactTune" showing slightly lower performance.
